ctx.x: But then you have to have -- the people have to buy it, and they stopped buying that. They were ready for something else, and they got it out of radio. So I'm not -- I can't deny that eight in and a bar -- did a lot of it with Shaw, did a lot of it with the Glen Gray band, that is, not to get mixed up with the early Casa Loma. That was when all these guys used percussive sounds, particularly in the bass. Everything had to be four beats.

And that's one of the things about that concert that I did. With all that Goldkette stuff, I still have it, but I'm not going to -- I wouldn't go up there and let a guy play four beats on the bass. And I was afraid of that, one of the things I was afraid of, although there were guys like Chauncy Morehouse plays fine two beat music.
